The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-costing-you-2|payment]]s verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

When it comes to selling digital products, the most commonly used platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle have limitations when it comes to countries they operate in. Stripe, for example, operates in 46 countries out of 195, leaving a significant number of countries without access to its services, while PayPal has been known to suspend accounts without notice, holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. On the other hand, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have more restrictive policies when it comes to countries they serve, and Paddle is not available in many countries at all. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, allowing digital creators to set up their own online stores without relying on these platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle often handle restricted countries by simply not operating there, leaving digital creators without a way to collect payments for their digital products. This can be a major problem for creators who need to sell their products to customers in these countries. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH can operate in any country, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer. This means that digital creators can set up their own online stores and collect payments without relying on these platforms, giving them full control over their commerce infrastructure.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle often charge high fees and have slow payment processing times. For example, Gumroad charges a transaction fee of 3.5%, while PayPal charges a fee of up to 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH charges a flat fee of 0.5% for payments, and payment processing times are typically much faster, giving digital creators more control over their finances.

A sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, allowing digital creators to set up their own online stores and collect payments without relying on Stripe or any other platform.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle often require digital creators to give up ownership of their commerce infrastructure, relying on the platform to handle everything for them. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH provides digital creators with full ownership and control over their commerce infrastructure, allowing them to automate and deliver their digital products as they see fit, without relying on any platform.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When it comes to choosing an architecture for selling digital products, digital creators need to consider their specific situation and needs. If they need to operate in a restricted country, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH is the best option. If they want to avoid high fees and slow payment processing times, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH is also the best option. And if they want to have full ownership and control over their commerce infrastructure, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH is the only option.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.

With a sovereign commerce infrastructure company like COREMERCH, digital creators can avoid high fees and slow payment processing times, and have full ownership and control over their commerce infrastructure.
